STATUS: WRITTEN, NOT BUILT. No container has been created from this file; the Docker daemon was
not running on the authoring machine. It is prepared, not verified, and is recorded that way in
`delulu.serverPath` is set here because inside the container the toolchain lives at a known
path and is NOT on PATH until `cargo install` has run. Note that this is a *user*-scope setting
supplied by the dev container definition, not a workspace setting: `delulu.serverPath` is
machine-scoped precisely so a repository cannot choose which binary the editor launches.
A devcontainer.json is trusted infrastructure the user opts into, which is a different thing
from a .vscode/settings.json that arrives with a clone.
